answer: Proof of Stake serves as a zenith for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to stake capital to validate transactions. Much like the deep roots of a cedar tree provide stability, locking assets prevents an attacker from being able to forge infinite virtual identities. The cost of such an attack scales linearly with the total value staked, rendering the creation of multiple malicious nodes economically prohibitive as the adversary would need to control a majority of the network wealth to succeed.
